column1: # The size budget (D020, 0122): gzip -9 of the shipped djs-wasm module (scripts/build-wasm.sh)
# must stay within 1.5x quickjs-wasi's. The gate's last step checks it with
# scripts/size/budget.py; until the module is within 1.5x, `ceiling_gzip` is a ratchet
# (lowered with --update, raised only by a recorded decision; last raised: D2892, 0204: the
# shipped module loads plain dumps itself; lowered by 0177, D2704: images are no persistence
# format, so the shipped module verifies none; lowered by 0225, D3090: core and alloc built for the module,
# panics abort without a message; lowered by 0226, D3100: the shipped and slim modules read the
# arena unchecked; raised by 0230, D3123: builtins' helpers inlined, pure leaves in the hot loop; raised by 0232,
# D3133: await, async return and Promise combinators without builtin calls; raised by 0231, D3127: sort, Map/Set, string +, push, join and
# Array.from fast paths, +0.9 KB; raised by 0232b,
# D3159: lazy internal closures, @fast resolving functions and then; raised by 0236, D3164: the
# construct path outside step, `new` entries; raised by 0241, D3192: ES modules' intrinsic
# table entries, realm slot and enum arms, +59 B, slim +138 B; raised by 0244, D3211: the
# encoding builtins' intrinsic table entries and dispatch arm, +112 B, slim +74 B; raised by 0251,
# D3263: builtins generated as Rust, +2,790 B, slim +2,778 B; raised by 0257, D3282: the elastic
# shadow stack, +182 B; lowered back by 0257, D3283; raised by 0268, D3393: property and element
# hits read from the tier-0 loop's slice, string keys through the heap's helpers, +142 B, slim +281 B;
# lowered back by 0268, D3394: call_intrinsic reads its arguments once and has one bad-argument exit;
# slim raised by 0270, D3411: Map/Set drains and new Set/Map(array) entries, slim +260 B, approved;
# raised by 0280, D3511: the construct path (D3410) from the owner's allowance (D3510), +389 B, slim +344 B;
# raised by 0280, D3512: object rest in Rust (D3491), +399 B, slim +466 B;
# raised by 0282, D3530: fast entries for builtin getters, typed arrays' named keys in the caches, +515 B, slim +478 B;
# raised by 0287, D3560: the one-unit string cache, +81 B over the ceiling (+187 B over main's module before 0285/0286), slim +80 B;
# raised by 0286, D3551: @fast builtin calls inside the loop, a primitive's builtin method from the cache slot, +403 B, slim +387 B;
# raised by 0288, D3570: for-of over strings out of the general path, +301 B, slim +291 B;
# raised by 0289, D3590/D3591: builtins charge fuel for their work, +1,163 B, slim +617 B;
# raised by 0294, D3601 (owner, 2026-11-23): the one shipped module has the dumper, 432,882 ->
# 767,573 B gzip measured, the ceiling that plus the slack; the 1.5x budget no longer holds and
# bringing the size down again is later work; lowered by 0297, D3640: the ABI's unused exports, the
# compile cache and the dump maps' export go, 767,573 -> 750,859 B; lowered by 0298, the dumper's
# diet: 750,859 -> 717,284 B, and D3660, the dumper optimized for size: -> 701,709 B; 0297, D3642:
# the slim build goes, 701,738 B: the guards were constant there; 0298: the parser's suspension-map
# hooks out of line, 698,440 B); raised by 0301, D3705: logical snapshots in the shipped module
# (the module, its import validation, the intrinsic names), 698,440 -> 769,623 B, the ceiling that
# plus the slack; 0304 removes the dumper and lowers it.
# quickjs_wasi_gzip: quickjs-wasi 3.6.2 quickjs.wasm (pi's engine), gzip -9.
# budget_allowance_gzip: added to 1.5x by the owner (D3510, 2026-11-21) to land the speedups
# parked for size, raised by 1,024 for the fuel fix (D3591, 2026-11-22); the ceiling below
# still rises only by recorded batches.
